title: [Lean] Bind checked byte slices to named artifact columns
body:
## Context and coverage

Explicit author-checked kappa = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918. Candidate base is ae95f60feec79897b153dba6459bb3f9fd4d7b8e. The package preserves its author-checked feb4dd177862175ea61e27f1cda7c6d124d39b55 context; exact selected-result, assembly, selected source and both relevant emitters are byte-identical at ae95. These generic theorems do not use or change kappa.

Finite coverage: generic finite arrays and byte arrays, arbitrary in-range offsets and lengths including empty fragments and endpoints; no selected artifact census or concrete selected witness execution.

Conditional-interface coverage: CheckedArraySlice executes bounds and complete ordered equality checks, deriving every original-position element and prefix/fragment/suffix decomposition. LocatedCompactEntry checks the supplied interval in the same original artifact that is parsed, then executes compact-fragment/named-dictionary recovery. Success yields parser equations, exact compact bytes, named ordered columns and the recovered restricted binary operator with both inverse laws. Completeness retains actual parser, slice and checked-Candidate premises.

Full-theorem coverage: no structural JSON field-span identification, general parser correctness, duplicate-key policy, file/digest authentication, physical execution/allocation, precision, recursive cost or full multiplication/runtime theorem. Literal containment plus named-value equality does not identify a parser field span.

## Checked evidence and reproduction

Two unchanged accepted sources total 14,013 bytes. Eleven clean standard-axiom probes and four complete printed types passed local Lean 4.21.0 checking and independent exact-source terminal review. ACCEPTANCE.json records evidence and limitations. REPRODUCTION.md gives a source-hash-checked 20-module order using exact prepared Lean 4.21.0 and Mathlib 308445d7985027f538e281e18df29ca16ede2ba3. Eighteen public prerequisites are referenced without copying. The publication recipe was inspected, not rerun; no additional local CI preflight or archive rebuild.

## Overlap and attribution

Compared existing PRs, including #1961, which provides compact fragment and named dictionary checks but explicitly excludes the separate slice witness. This chunk adds checked same-artifact byte containment and the located recovery consumer. Exact source/module searches found no duplicate PR. The newer complete-object layout and key-only witness are excluded.

Credit: Lean/Mathlib Array/List authors; Jeremy Kothe T16/PR514; Rohan Arun PR1094; accepted bank/frame byte, slice, compact and recovery components. James Chang with OpenAI assistance. Apache-2.0. No broad novelty claim.
